parts.label: Radiators — front left and right (x2)
parts.function: Twin aluminium radiators angled into the 987's front bumper corner inlets dissipate engine heat from the mid-mounted flat-six. Their lower corners trap leaves and road debris — the classic 987 corrosion spot; clear the fins and drains yearly.

parts.label: Radiator fan modules (x2)
parts.function: Electric fan modules draw air through each corner radiator to maintain coolant temperature at low vehicle speeds or when stationary, staged by coolant temperature and A/C demand.

parts.label: Coolant thermostat
parts.function: Wax-element thermostat in the engine's coolant outlet housing that opens flow to the long front radiator circuits once the engine is warm (the electronically map-controlled thermostat arrived later, with the 981). Aftermarket low-temperature thermostats are a common 987 track upgrade.

parts.label: Auxiliary coolant pump (electric)
parts.function: Small electric circulation pump that keeps coolant moving after hot shut-down and supports the heater circuit, protecting the mid-engine bay from heat-soak.

parts.label: Coolant pump (belt-driven external module)
parts.function: On the 987.2 9A1 engine the coolant pump is no longer integrated in the crankcase: it is an external belt-driven module on the cylinder bank 1–3 side, with maximum volume flow raised approx. 20% over the 987.1 M96/M97 pump (2009 Service Introduction, doc p23).

parts.label: Coolant expansion tank
parts.function: Expansion tank in the engine compartment with the pressure cap and cold-level marks (the 996-era luggage-compartment tank is gone). Accommodates coolant volume changes and provides the system fill and bleed point — check cold, never open hot.

parts.label: Coolant hoses (engine circuits)
parts.function: Moulded engine-bay coolant hoses with spring-band clamps connecting the flat-six to the chassis pipes that run the length of the car to the front radiators.

parts.label: Engine oil cooler / heat exchanger
parts.function: Water-to-oil heat exchanger on the engine transfers excess heat from engine oil into the coolant circuit, warming oil quickly from cold and capping peak oil temperatures.

parts.label: Oil temperature sensor
parts.function: NTC oil temperature sensor reports real-time oil temperature to the DME for fuel and ignition mapping adjustments and driver instrument display.

parts.label: Coolant pump housing
parts.function: Cast housing of the external pump module (987.2) enclosing the impeller and routing pressurized coolant into the crankcase passages; on the 987.1 M96/M97 the pump sits in the crankcase itself.

parts.label: Water guide housing
parts.function: Engine casting that directs coolant from the pump outlet through defined passages for the cylinder-head cross-flow cooling — revamped on the 9A1 to target the hot spots around the exhaust valve seats (2009 Service Introduction, doc p24).

parts.label: Coolant temperature sensor (engine)
parts.function: NTC sensor mounted in the engine coolant circuit reports coolant temperature to the DME for closed-loop cooling control and dashboard gauge display.

parts.label: Water level sender (coolant reservoir)
parts.function: Float-type sender in the expansion tank triggers a low-coolant warning on the instrument cluster when the coolant level drops below the minimum mark.

parts.label: Radiator air guide (left and right)
parts.function: Plastic air-guide panels channel airflow from the bumper corner inlets through the radiator cores and prevent recirculation of hot air around the radiator sides.

parts.label: Coolant pipes (front-to-rear chassis lines)
parts.function: Rigid aluminium coolant pipes running along the sills the length of the mid-engine chassis, connecting the front radiators to the engine at the rear — inspect for corrosion where clips trap moisture.

parts.label: Coolant pump pulley
parts.function: Pulley on the external coolant pump module driven by the accessory belt — the 987.2 pump is belt-driven from outside the crankcase, simplifying pump replacement.

parts.label: Thermostat housing seal / O-ring
parts.function: Elastomeric seal between the thermostat and its housing prevents coolant leaks at the junction under operating pressure and temperature cycling.

parts.label: Coolant reservoir pressure cap
parts.function: Pressure-relief cap on the expansion tank maintains system pressure at the specified rating — a weak cap causes slow pressure loss and is the first cheap check for unexplained coolant loss on a 987.

parts.label: Centre radiator (optional third radiator)
parts.function: Auxiliary centre radiator low between the two corner units — fitted to hot-climate cars and automatic-transmission cars (Tiptronic S on the 987.1, common with PDK on the 987.2), and a popular retrofit for track use.

parts.label: Coolant feed line — engine to radiators
parts.function: Carries hot coolant from the engine outlet forward to the top of the front radiators; the high-pressure leg of the 987's long mid-engine cooling loop.

parts.label: Coolant return line — radiators to pump
parts.function: Returns cooled coolant from the radiator bottom tanks back along the chassis to the coolant pump inlet; the low-pressure return leg of the main circuit.

parts.label: Heater hose — supply (engine to heater core)
parts.function: Flexible hose that routes hot coolant from the engine forward to the cabin heater core to provide interior heating.

parts.label: Heater hose — return (heater core to engine)
parts.function: Returns cooled coolant from the heater core back to the engine inlet completing the cabin heating sub-circuit.

parts.label: Heater pipeline (HVAC coolant line)
parts.function: Rigid coolant pipeline routed through the front structure connecting the HVAC heater circuit to the main engine cooling loop.

parts.label: Crossover pipe — left circuit
parts.function: Rigid pipe bridging the left-side coolant circuit between the engine and the left front radiator; maintains balanced flow in the split cooling layout.

parts.label: Crossover pipe — right circuit
parts.function: Rigid pipe bridging the right-side coolant circuit between the engine and the right front radiator; mirrors the left crossover for symmetrical flow distribution.

parts.label: Expansion tank feed hose
parts.function: Connects the pressurized cooling circuit to the expansion tank, allowing coolant to flow into the reservoir as temperature and pressure rise.

parts.label: Coolant overflow hose
parts.function: Routes excess coolant vented from the reservoir pressure cap to a safe drain path, preventing spillage on hot engine-bay components.

parts.label: Coolant distributor tube — left bank
parts.function: Internal distribution tube directing coolant to multiple outlets on the left cylinder bank for the flat-six's cross-flow jacket cooling.

parts.label: Coolant distributor tube — right bank
parts.function: Internal distribution tube directing coolant to multiple outlets on the right cylinder bank for the flat-six's cross-flow jacket cooling.

parts.label: Coolant bleeder screw
parts.function: Bleed screw at the high point of the cooling circuit allows trapped air to be purged during fill — essential on the 987's long front-radiator plumbing to prevent air-lock.

parts.label: Coolant temperature sensor — radiator outlet
parts.function: Second NTC temperature sensor at the radiator outlet monitors coolant temperature returning from the front radiators; used by the DME and the electric fan control logic.

parts.label: Coolant drain plug / sealing plug
parts.function: Block-mounted sealing plug opened during coolant service to gravity-drain the engine passages; re-sealed with a new washer to prevent weeping.

parts.label: Radiator fan — left (electric)
parts.function: Left-side electric fan mounted behind the left front radiator, activated on coolant temperature or A/C compressor demand.

parts.label: Fan control module (radiator fan controller)
parts.function: Electronic module receives DME and A/C signals to regulate electric radiator fan speed, enabling staged / variable cooling management.

parts.label: Coolant breather / vent line
parts.function: Small-bore flexible line that vents air from the high points of the front radiator circuit back to the expansion tank, keeping the long 987 system liquid-filled.

parts.label: Internal coolant water pipe (crankcase)
parts.function: Water pipe inside the crankcase routing coolant from the pump outlet into the internal galleries for cylinder and head cooling.

parts.label: A/C condenser air guide
parts.function: Air-guide duct ahead of the A/C condenser ensures ram air flows through the condenser before the radiator core; condenser heat rejected here adds to the frontal heat load the fans must manage — another reason to keep the 987's inlets clear of debris.

parts.label: PDK fluid cooler (transmission oil cooler)
parts.function: Coolant-to-oil heat exchanger for the PDK dual-clutch transaxle on PDK-equipped 987.2 cars, warming transmission fluid from cold and capping peak temperatures. 987.1 Tiptronic S uses its own ATF cooling circuit instead.

parts.label: Water hose — reservoir circuit
parts.function: Short connecting hose between the expansion tank and the main coolant circuit neck, completing the pressurized reservoir loop.
